services.desc: Most of Virginia State Parks offer boat rentals including canoes, kayaks, paddleboats, stand-up paddleboards, Jon boats, motorized boats and tubes. The parks below are sorted by region. Know before you go! Rental fees and availability vary by park. Availability is also affected by staffing levels. Visit the park's "Know Before You Go" section for specific operating schedules. Rentals may also be suspended due to weather. Virginia State Parks now has easy self-serve kayak kiosks at 10 parks. services.desc: Overnight accommodations, picnic shelters and some meeting facilities are available for reservations up to 11 months in advance through our online and call-in reservation system. services.name: Fishing, Boating
services.desc: While there’s no fishing within this 1.5-acre park, the Powell River’s headwaters in Wise County offer good fishing for redbreast sunfish, rock bass, smallmouth bass, catfish and muskie. There are no public access points on the Powell River so anglers should get permission from the landowner before accessing the river
